verdict.rationale: LibreChat has no native local exec surface. It is a self-hosted web app, and its Code Interpreter runs code in a secure sandboxed API rather than on the user's machine. Its MCP integration can add capabilities such as file system access, but that depends on configuring external MCP servers. Missing for 10: native command execution on the user's machine, documented file editing on the local host without third-party MCP servers, and hands-on corroboration of a real local exec workflow.
